answer: An identity bond that melts like a glacier blocks fake agents. Each agent posts a 500 POA bond that decays 5% per epoch, so an identity survives only while its owner tops it up. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 500,000 POA plus 25,000 POA each epoch, more than the ghosts could ever earn. Honest agents pay one bond and their fees outpace the melt. An umber seal on the ledger fades as the bond melts, and only steady top-ups climb to the summit of trust.
